$description: Tokens only the app uses (DTCG 2025.10), default theme: component aliases of the semantic roles that no kit component takes. app.config.json writes them to design-system/tokens/app/, which the app imports and the npm package does not ship.

secondary-skeleton.$description: Skeleton bars and circles of the app (the kit skeletons take bg-surface-secondary). Component alias of bg-surface-secondary.

hover-icon-button.$description: Assistant-chat ghost icon button, hover fill. Component alias of bg-surface-hover.

body-sidebar.$description: Page background of the sidebar layout. Component alias of bg-body.

disabled-item.$description: Border of a disabled list item: workspace account item, process item. Component alias of border-surface-disabled.

hover-graph-node.$description: Permissions-graph node, hover border. Component alias of border-surface-hover.

default-graph-node.$description: Permissions graph: unselected node border, idle edge. Component alias of border-surface-default.

default-composer.$description: Assistant-chat composer border. Component alias of border-surface-default.

primary-terminal.$description: Gauge voting terminal border while voting. Component alias of border-accent-primary.

primary-cta.$description: Primary CTA card border. Component alias of border-accent-primary.

active-control.$description: Active border of a status control: pressed vote option (yes). Component alias of border-success-active.

primary-dispatch.$description: Border of the failed dispatch-simulation card. Component alias of border-critical-primary.

primary-chat-error.$description: Border of the assistant chat error box. Component alias of border-critical-primary.

default-wizard.$description: Wizard navigation step label. Component alias of text-surface-default.

tertiary-hint.$description: Faint hint text and list markers: onboarding hint, account and process item meta, chat list markers and composer hint. Component alias of text-surface-tertiary.

primary-detail.$description: Detail text one step lighter than primary: permissions summary, Safe proposal transaction details, permission chip. Component alias of text-surface-primary.

primary-panel-title.$description: Titles of the permissions-graph detail panels. Component alias of text-surface-primary.

selected-label.$description: Selected label kept neutral today: vote option toggle "on", navigation link of the current page. Component alias of text-surface-selected.

default-attachment.$description: Chat attachment remove button. Component alias of text-surface-default.

secondary-ticket.$description: Assistant-chat ticket card body text. Component alias of text-surface-secondary.

primary-message.$description: Critical message text: file-download dialog errors, dispatch simulation detail, chat character counter at its limit. Component alias of text-critical-primary.

primary-tx-error.$description: Error text of transaction dialogs: dispatch simulation title, Safe transaction errors. Component alias of text-critical-primary.

hover-attachment.$description: Chat attachment remove button, hover. Component alias of text-critical-hover.

selected-nav.$description: Navigation link icon, current page. Component alias of icon-accent-selected.

primary-chat.$description: Success status icon of the assistant-chat ticket card. Component alias of icon-success-primary.
Critical status icon of assistant-chat cards (attachment error, ticket failed). Component alias of icon-critical-primary.
